definitions.explanation: A flowering shrub with large, rounded clusters of flowers that bloom in various colors including blue, pink, purple, and white.

examples.japanese: ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{紫陽花|あじさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}く→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: Hydrangeas bloom during the rainy season.

examples.japanese: {紫陽花|あじさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{酸性度|さんせいど}→酸性度：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The color of hydrangea flowers changes depending on the soil's acidity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鎌倉|かまくら}→鎌倉：30711_kamakura⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{紫陽花|あじさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名所|めいしょ}→名所：08164_meisho⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Kamakura is famous as a hydrangea viewing spot.

notes:
The iconic flower of Japan's rainy season (⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧, June-July). Also written as アジサイ.

Flower color depends on soil pH:
- ⟦{酸性|さんせい}→酸性：00454_sansei⟧ (acidic soil) → ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧ (blue)
- ⟦{中性|ちゅうせい}→中性：18084_chuusei⟧〜⟦アルカリ{性|せい}→アルカリ：28621_arukari⟧ (neutral-alkaline) → ⟦ピンク→ピンク：04718_pinku⟧/⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧ (pink/red)
- ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧ (white) varieties don't change

Famous viewing locations (⟦{名所|めいしょ}→名所：08164_meisho⟧):
- ⟦{鎌倉|かまくら}→鎌倉：30711_kamakura⟧ (⟦{長谷寺|はせでら}→長谷寺：noentry⟧, ⟦{明月院|めいげついん}→明月院：noentry⟧)
- ⟦{箱根|はこね}→箱根：30712_hakone⟧
- ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧

Cultural note: Hydrangeas symbolize the rainy season in art and literature. They appear frequently in ⟦{季語|きご}→季語：09561_kigo⟧ (seasonal words) for summer haiku.

Varieties:
- ⟦{額|がく}{紫陽花|あじさい}→額紫陽花：noentry⟧ (lacecap hydrangea)
- ⟦{西洋|せいよう}{紫陽花|あじさい}→西洋紫陽花：noentry⟧ (mophead hydrangea)
